The background includes a blurred office or home environment.

The keys on the laptop keyboard in the background lack distinct separation and individual character legends. They appear slightly melted or fused together, lacking the crisp geometric precision expected of real hardware.

The bottom edge of the iPod where it meets the surface has a slight softness and ambiguity in the shadow contact point, making it look slightly like it's floating or merging with the surface rather than resting firmly.
